value.rationale: A natural complete all-graph, all-two-parameter classification separates vertex exchangeability from coordinate exchangeability of observed edge coincidences. The triangle has a mathematically motivated exact integer finite-extension invariant, unlike the infinitely extendible star/matching models; the sharp ceiling and unique constructive witness identify the precise limit of an exchangeable Bernoulli surrogate for pair co-clustering observations. This is a structural finite-classification result rather than an arbitrary parameter slice or known table recomputation.
